rows.label: qst650604_msg0001
rows.name:
According to the old man,
the bandits' hideout should be
around here somewhere[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650604_msg0023
rows.name:
[ML:Dash ]Come to think of it, M.O.M.O.
looked different earlier.
Was that a transformation?

rows.label: qst650604_msg0024
rows.name:
Um[ML:Dash ] It's a little different
from transforming[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650604_msg0025
rows.name:
That was power from the other side
taking shape in this world.
It's called Imaginary Mode.

rows.label: qst650604_msg0026
rows.name: The other side[ML:Dash ]?

rows.label: qst650604_msg0027
rows.name:
Well... Even M.O.M.O. has trouble
explaining it properly.

rows.label: qst650604_msg0028
rows.name:
It's something like a world of
possibilities, free of the bounds of
time and space[ML:Dash ] Does that help?

rows.label: qst650604_msg0029
rows.name:
M.O.M.O. can use that power
without even realizing it[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650604_msg0030
rows.name:
Hmm[ML:Dash ] Do you mean literally
every possibility?

rows.label: qst650604_msg0031
rows.name:
Yes[ML:Dash ] But while M.O.M.O. can
use the power, she can't select
which possibility to bring about[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650604_msg0032
rows.name:
If M.O.M.O. could choose,
any wish could come true[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650604_msg0033
rows.name: That's amazing, mo!!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0034
rows.name:
If all possibilities could really
be made real[ML:Dash ] Think of this,
and that[ML:Dash ] Moffuffu.

rows.label: qst650604_msg0035
rows.name: Master, that's awful, mo[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650604_msg0036
rows.name: Nmo!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0037
rows.name:
But that power does carry danger.
If used wrongly, it could bring
about destruction[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650604_msg0038
rows.name: [ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650604_msg0039
rows.name:
Perhaps that's why such power was
given to someone as innocent as
M.O.M.O.[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650604_msg0040
rows.name:
Yeah! We trust M.O.M.O. to use
that power the right way!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0041
rows.name: Yes! M.O.M.O. will do her best!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0042
rows.name:
Anyway, where have those
bandits got to[ML:Dash ]?

rows.label: qst650604_msg0002
rows.name:
[ML:Dash ]They're coming!
The bandits, and one more person!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0003
rows.name: Tch! They spotted us again!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0004
rows.name: Boss! It's those guys!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0005
rows.name:
The Driver and Blades who
made fools of us!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0006
rows.name: So these are the ones[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650604_msg0007
rows.name:
Hey, you lot! I hear you made
fools of the Four Brothers of Steel,
whose name silences crying kids!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0008
rows.name: [ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650604_msg0009
rows.name: [ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650604_msg0010
rows.name: [ML:Dash ]Lame.

rows.label: qst650604_msg0011
rows.name: No sense of style, mo.

rows.label: qst650604_msg0012
rows.name: Sh-shut up!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0013
rows.name:
You lot with your flashy Blades
could never understand
a soul of steel!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0014
rows.name: Well said!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0015
rows.name: That's our boss!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0016
rows.name:
So it's jealousy after all.
How pathetic.

rows.label: qst650604_msg0017
rows.name:
Give back the Life Stone you stole
from old man Lazaro a month ago!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0018
rows.name: Or I'll break your nose!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0019
rows.name: Huh? I don't know any stone!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0020
rows.name:
You'll pay for mouthing off
like that!

rows.label: qst650604_msg0021
rows.name:
If you've forgotten,
I'll jog your memory!
